characters.description: The narrator and one of two viewpoint characters, a Divergent young woman who has survived the fall of the faction system. Brave and stubborn, still carrying grief and guilt from the war, she is determined to learn the truth of the world beyond the wall now that the city's founding secret has been revealed.
characters.name: Tris Prior

characters.description: Tobias Eaton, once the Dauntless instructor called Four, Tris's love and fellow leader, and the book's second viewpoint character. The son of Marcus and Evelyn, he struggles with his loyalties as his mother rules the city and the truth about the outside world begins to unfold.
characters.name: Four

characters.description: Tris's brother, a brilliant and cautious Erudite mind who betrayed her to Jeanine during the war and now awaits punishment under the new regime. Guilt-ridden and estranged, he is desperate for a chance to make amends.
characters.name: Caleb Prior

characters.description: Tris's blunt, loyal friend, a former Candor transfer to Dauntless who has stood with her through the war. Grieving her own losses, she remains one of Tris's closest companions.
characters.name: Christina

characters.description: The cruel, self-serving former initiate who has repeatedly been Tris's enemy. Unpredictable and out only for himself, he attaches to the group again for reasons of his own.
characters.name: Peter

characters.description: Tobias's mother and leader of the factionless, who has seized control of the city after the faction system collapsed. Ruling harshly, she confiscates weapons and suppresses dissent, provoking resistance and straining her fragile bond with Tobias.
characters.name: Evelyn Johnson

characters.description: Tobias's father and a former Abnegation leader, determined to restore the factions and reclaim power. Self-justifying and manipulative, he aligns himself with those who oppose Evelyn's rule.
characters.name: Marcus Eaton

characters.description: The scarred former spokeswoman of Amity, who now leads the Allegiant, a movement loyal to the old factions and to the message urging the city's people to leave for the world outside.
characters.name: Johanna Reyes

characters.description: A good-humored, brave Dauntless-born friend of Tris who joins the group leaving the city. Loyal and quick to joke, he has lost much in the fighting.
characters.name: Uriah

characters.description: A level-headed Erudite woman, sister of Tris's dead friend Will, who has become a voice of reason among the Allegiant. Logical and calm under pressure, she joins the group venturing beyond the wall.
characters.name: Cara

characters.description: The director of the Bureau of Genetic Welfare, the government compound the travelers discover beyond the wall. Composed and authoritative, he presents himself as the steward of the outside world's order and of the long project that created and watched the city.
characters.name: David

characters.description: A young scientist at the Bureau of Genetic Welfare who takes an interest in the newcomers and quietly helps Tris and Tobias understand the compound, its history, and its aims.
characters.name: Matthew
